name: Things in Rings

categories.label: Team won (every Finder emptied their hand)
categories.labelVi: Cả đội thắng (mọi Finder hết bài)
categories.hint: Lose if the Knower must place a clue but has none left.

winCondition: Every Finder must place their 5 Things correctly. After each round of Finder turns the Knower places 1 new clue. If the Knower needs to place a clue but has none, everyone loses; if every Finder empties their hand first, everyone wins.

endCondition.description: Win when all Finders empty their hands; lose when the Knower runs out of clues

notes: family: coop. Variant for 2-4 players: Knower draws 10 Things, places 1 clue per player including self, keeps the rest as hand to place later clues.
